text:
PulseFrame is a fast-growing health-tech startup building a clinician-facing platform that turns complex patient data into intuitive, actionable interfaces. We move quickly, ship weekly, and care deeply about design and performance.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain high-performance, accessible UI components and pages using React and Next.js.
- Own feature development from design handoff through QA and production rollout.
- Manage application state and side effects with Redux; design predictable, testable state models.
- Write type-safe UI code in TypeScript and improve typing across the codebase.
- Optimize client-side performance, bundle size, and perceived load time.
- Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to define APIs and component contracts.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to frontend architecture and best practices.

What we need
- 4+ years experience
- Strong experience with React
- Strong experience with Next.js
- Strong experience with Redux
- Strong experience with TypeScript

Bonus points
- Cypress
- Webpack
- Tailwind CSS

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Mumbai or Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
